title: The Mechitharist Fathers of Venice and Vienna, three centuries of Armenian letters #Armenia
description:
Founded in 1701 by Mekhitar of Sebaste, the Mechitharist Fathers turned the island of San Lazzaro in Venice, and later Vienna, into centers of the Armenian language and letters.
